venue.name: Gopal Tent House
venue.description: Grand lawns, royal shamianas and handcrafted mandaps — hosting unforgettable weddings for over three decades.

mission: For three generations, Gopal Tent House has raised tents and lit lawns for the families of Vrindavan. We believe a wedding is not a transaction — it is a promise made in front of everyone a family loves. Our work is to make sure nothing on that day goes wrong: the canopy holds, the food arrives hot, the lights come on when the baraat turns the corner. Everything else is yours to enjoy.

venues.name: Vrindavan Terrace

about.title: Three Generations of Weddings
about.content: Gopal Tent House began in 1992 with a single hand-stitched shamiana and a borrowed truck. Today we run four bookable venues, an in-house kitchen and a crew of over forty — but the job has not changed. We put up the tent, we light the ground, and we make sure a family can stand in the middle of their own wedding without worrying about a single thing.
about.story: Everything is handled under one roof: the ground, the tent, the decor, the mandap, the food, the lights and the furniture. Families deal with one team and one bill instead of chasing six vendors. That is why most of our bookings still come from someone who attended a wedding here and asked for our number.
values: One team, one bill, no chasing vendors
